metadata.title: Canada Olympic Park local terrain samples
metadata.sourceTitle: High Resolution Digital Elevation Model (HRDEM) - CanElevation Series
metadata.attribution: Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence – Canada.
metadata.method: Local x-east, z-south offsets converted to WGS84 around origin with R=6378137, then EPSG:3979; bilinear interpolation of the source 1 m bare-earth DTM pixel centres, rounded to 0.01 m. Source is a local window read from the cloud-optimized GeoTIFF. Row 0 starts at zMin; column 0 starts at xMin. Values are absolute orthometric metres, with no vertical exaggeration, artificial slopes, or map-edge blending applied.
metadata.limitations: Bare-earth data does not encode ramp decks, towers or tree/building heights. The survey date describes the source collection, not current site structures. For illustrative terrain only.
metadata.displayTreatment: The map subtracts the local datum and blends the outer edge into its otherwise flat basemap. Sampled elevations remain unmodified in this file; the map mesh is an orientation aid, not a terrain survey or current site inventory.
